newsitem.title: USA: Conversion Tech loses client Thomson.
newsitem.headline: Conversion Tech loses client Thomson.

text.p: Thomson Consumer Electronics will end shipments of cathode ray tube glass cullet to a unit of Conversion Technologies International Inc as well as purchases of recycled cathode ray tube glass cullet from it, Conversion said Friday.

The company, which recycles the glass for major electronics manufacturers, said Thomson accounted for about 16.5 percent of its consolidated revenues for the fiscal year ended June 30 and 26.6 percent of consolidated revenues for the quarter ended September 30.
Its unit was called Dunkirk International Glass & Ceramics Corporation.
Conversion said its recent agreement to merge with Octagon Inc would help ease the impact of Thomson's decision.

On a pro-forma consolidated basis, Thomson's shipments of the glass would represent less than 1.6 percent of the company's current annual revenues given the planned merger with Octagon in the first quarter of next year, it said.
